question.text:
Given below are two statement : one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R

Assertion A : 5f electron can participate in bonding to a far greater extent than 4f electrons

Reason R : 5f orbitals are not as buried as 4f orbitals

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.text: A is false but R is true
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A

solution.text: The distance between the nucleus and 5f orbital is more than the distance between the nucleus and 4f orbital. Hence the hold of nucleus on valence electron decrease in 5f orbital. 5f orbital not buried as 4f oribitals so electron present in 5f orbital experience less nuclear attraction than electron present in 4f orbital. Hence electrons of 5f orbital can take part in bonding to far great extent.
